title: tdh.util.audioInUtility.ui~
description: `tdh.util.audioInUtility.ui~` is a utility module that provides two-channel audio input from the ADC or a straightforward audio-file player, with channel muting, input gain, post-fader metering, and DSP controls. It is intended primarily for help patches and demonstrations; enable LOOP for repeated file playback, and use `tdh.util.audiofile~` when more advanced playback is needed.
